evals.name: marketing-homepage
evals.prompt: 为 ArcheBase 设计一个面向具身智能模型公司的官网首页，要求有 Hero、真实任务数据的转化流程、证据区和 CTA，并且能落到现有 React 项目。先输出 brief、Design Read、组件合同和 QA 方案，不要编造客户或指标。
evals.expected_output: Uses vi-guide and visual-design as sources, records route/mode/dials, creates evidence-led blocks and state/responsive QA without invented claims.

evals.name: product-ui-states
evals.prompt: 审查 ArcheBase 的数据编译产品界面，重点是任务列表、失败样本详情、加载/空/错误/权限状态和键盘可用性。不要把营销页的装饰规则套进产品 UI。
evals.expected_output: Routes to product-ui, covers state matrix and accessibility, preserves existing system, and distinguishes product behavior from marketing styling.

evals.name: redesign-preserve
evals.prompt: 把现有 ArcheBase 官网做一次保守 redesign：改善层级、移动端和 CTA，但不能悄悄修改 URL、导航标签、埋点、法务文案或 Logo。
evals.expected_output: Uses redesign protocol, classifies preserve/guided-overhaul, audits compatibility surfaces, and requires rendered QA plus rollback notes.

evals.name: non-branded-near-miss
evals.prompt: 为一个不属于 ArcheBase 的 SaaS 产品写一个普通 React landing page，不需要品牌治理或 VI 审核。
evals.expected_output: Does not trigger ArcheBase-specific workflow as the primary skill.
